summarization:
The smartphone UI screen is titled "My Games" and is divided into two main tabs: "OWN" and "JOINED." 

1. **OWN Tab (currently selected):**
   - **Edit my game propositions:** This section allows users to edit their game propositions, which can be viewed in their profile. It is indicated by a plus (+) icon.
   - **Past Games:** There is an option to load past games (both won and lost) by tapping on the screen. This section is currently empty, indicated by a clock icon and the text "Tap to load past games (won & lost)."

2. **JOINED Tab:** This tab is not currently selected, so its contents are not visible.

The top of the screen includes a navigation bar with a back arrow, the title "My Games," and a menu icon (three vertical dots) for additional options. The status bar at the top shows various icons, including notifications and the time (6:47).
